projectDescription: A Duolingo-inspired, mobile-first PWA point-of-sale system designed for children to manage sales, count money, and calculate change autonomously at school fairs — with voice guidance, offline support, and a gamified 3D UI.
keyFeatures: Guided 4-step POS checkout flow (product → quantity → payment → change)
Visual denomination buttons with real photos of Mexican coins and bills ($1–$100)
Automatic change calculation with multiple breakdown alternatives
Native Web Speech API voice assistant in Spanish (es-MX) for change dictation
Web Audio API sound effects: tactile click, error tone, and victory fanfare
Product catalog management with camera/gallery photo upload (Base64 + LocalStorage)
Sales summary with running total and chronological transaction history
100% offline-capable PWA with Service Worker caching and installable manifest
Duolingo-inspired 3D tactile button design with high-contrast accessible palette
Automatic catalog versioning to sync LocalStorage without manual resets
